defects: `Finsupp.embDomain embed f` and `Finsupp.support f` are applied directly to `f : Polynomial R`, but both `Finsupp.embDomain` and `Finsupp.support` expect an argument of type `ℕ →₀ R` (a Finsupp), not a `Polynomial R`; there is no implicit coercion from `Polynomial R` to its underlying Finsupp in Mathlib, so as written this almost certainly fails to elaborate (missing a `.toFinsupp` or equivalent projection)

Statement never invokes `Polynomial.toLaurent` / `LaurentPolynomial` at all, instead trying to manually reconstruct the Laurent polynomial's coefficient Finsupp via `Finsupp.embDomain`; this changes the object being reasoned about from 'the produced Laurent polynomial's coeff support' to an ad hoc reconstruction, rather than the same proposition up to notation

Equality is recast at the `Set` level via coercions (`(... : Set ℤ)`, `Set.image`) instead of the gold's direct `Finset` equality (`Finset.map`), an unmotivated structural change that is not merely notation

Uses a custom embedding `⟨Int.ofNat, Int.ofNat_injective⟩` instead of the standard `Nat.castEmbedding` used in gold; even if mathematically the same map, combined with the type mismatch above this is unverified as elaborating correctly
